messages:
Mike (Sales): Hey team — greenline contract signed this morning. passing to CS for kickoff. key things: SSO (Okta), private eval cluster for 90 days, expected ~400k tokens/month first 3 months, major concern: latency spikes noted in their POC (avg 180ms, spikes to 420ms) — could be renewal risk if not stable. assigning @Julia to lead.

Julia (CS): Thanks Mike. quick Qs: who will own SSO config, who from eng should join the launch call, and what's the preferred date window for kickoff next week?

Mike (Sales): SSO owner = Greenline IT (contact: sara.green@greenline.com). On our side: Elaine (CSM) will own enablement; Nina from infra-eng should join for the private eval + perf. kickoff window: Tue/Wed next week (Apr 8-9) — Sara prefers mornings.

Elaine (CSM): looping in Nina. i'll set the kickoff and run the enablement playbook. proposed agenda:
```
- intros & goals (10m)
- SSO requirements & ownership (15m)
- Private eval plan + infra details (20m)
- Perf SLAs & smoke test plan (15m)
- next steps & owners (10m)
```
I'll book Tue 8am PT if that works for all.

Nina (Eng): ok i'm in for Tue. quick notes on infra side:
- private eval = ephemeral VPC with shared prefix caching
- need greenline IP allowlist + staging API key
- perf smoke tests: we'll run seq len 512 workloads and concurrent sessions ~50
I can prepare a short checklist and a staging token for the call.

Mike (Sales): Sara confirmed Tue morning works. thanks Elaine.

Elaine (CSM): Owners + quick action items I captured:
- Elaine (CSM): kickoff scheduling + enablement deck
- Nina (Eng): staging token + perf smoke checklist
- Julia (CS): onboarding runbook, training sessions, success criteria
- Mike (Sales): Sara contact + contract notes
Target: kickoff Tue 8am PT; prework items due by Mon EOD.

Julia (CS): i'll draft success criteria doc and share prompt/traffic expectations. also will collect customer eval questions to add to the runbook.

Nina (Eng): creating infra ticket now and will attach the staging token. linking eng playbook for smoke tests: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/perf-smoke

oncall-bot: Ticket INC-2345 created by Nina (Eng) for Greenline private-eval provisioning — https://redwood.internal/incidents/2345

Elaine (CSM): great. one more note on renewal risk — Mike flagged latency concerns. Nina, can you add an alert threshold we can monitor during eval? proposing actionable thresholds: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 500ms; if breached twice in 24h -> escalation to eng-sre.

Nina (Eng): yep will add alerts to the staging dashboard and hook to eng-sre. will also include an automated report for the first 7 days post-kickoff.

Mike (Sales): appreciated. i'll loop Sara into this thread once kickoff time is confirmed.

Julia (CS): thanks all — i'll post the runbook link here once ready and create calendar invite. :thumbsup:

Elaine (CSM): closing notes — owners confirm? please react with :white_check_mark: when you've taken the action you own.

Mike (Sales): ✅

Nina (Eng): ✅ will post ticket link when infra creds ready.

Julia (CS): ✅ starting runbook draft.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Kickoff - Tue 08:00 PT (automated)
